scope: bounded explicit discrete constant-acceleration trajectory and independent closed-form differential numerical checks; no arbitrary physics/HPC claim; native execution in fresh local handlers, SQLite SQL-function transactions and a bounded worker-thread dataflow pipeline; no cloud FaaS, arbitrary SQL, external stream or OS sandbox claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: SQLite reopen recovery and rejected-result rollback
authorityProfile: local source/binary-bound job execution, frozen cases and unchanged fresh independent proposals; no new hosted CI

trials.intent: Each explicit step advances position by the old velocity, then adds acceleration to velocity, and appends the new position to the trajectory.
The closed-form position must match explicit integration where position is advanced with old velocity before acceleration changes that velocity.
The final velocity after a given number of constant-acceleration discrete steps must match the explicit step integrator, including zero steps.
